data.decision: Restore and protect the active reviewed operator; do not treat it as a disposable merged-PR worktree. Add a narrow cleanup-retention instruction and preserve original source/receipt/policy/cohort/deadline. Notify Cameron once about the recurrence and guard, without claiming the root cause is fixed or pausing/rescheduling the task.

Monitor the next existing run normally; if removal recurs despite the guard, surface the specific failure without moving production pins, lowering publishing gates or starting another experiment.
